self = @allure.title("p11: Navigate to DailyStandUp_Cohort, open Direct Message, hover user and validate email tooltip") @pytest.mark.priority(11) def test_hover_user_tooltip(self): self.direct_message.select_cohort("DailyStandUp_Cohort") self.direct_message.navigate_to_direct_message() > self.direct_message.hover_user_and_validate_tooltip(self.USER_EMAIL) tests/PlayWrightTests/CoachFacingPortal/test_coach_direct_message.py:126: _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ self = email = 'abdul+test@habitnu.com' def hover_user_and_validate_tooltip(self, email): """Hover the user's conversation-list row and validate the email tooltip appears. The row shows the user's email (often truncated, e.g. 'abdul+test@habitnu.c...') inside a react-bootstrap OverlayTrigger; the tooltip `
{email}
` is only added to the DOM on hover. react-bootstrap binds the tooltip to the email TEXT element's `mouseenter`, which does NOT bubble — so hovering the wrapping `.room-sub` container never triggers it.
